t.It is not just how much water is in a fo: Ba wai nawa ne yawan ruwa a cikin abinci ba, amma nawa ne kyauta don microbes don amfani. Masana kimiyya suna kiran wannan aikin ruwa (written aw), wanda aka auna daga 0 zuwa 1. Ruwa mai tsabta shine 1.0. Sabbin 'ya'yan itace yana kusa da 1.0. Busasshen abinci da ya dace kamar busassun garri, ƙwanƙwasa guntu da busasshiyar barkono suna zaune ƙasa da waɗannan matakan, shi ya sa suke ajiyewa.

t.**Salt** pulls water out of food and out: Gishiri yana fitar da ruwa daga abinci kuma daga cikin ƙwayoyin cuta. Ana amfani da shi a cikin busasshen kifi, kayan lambu mai gishiri da wasu kayan yaji.
